symbolic.residual_convention: app minus recurrence RHS has h^2 coefficient -2*tau*k; its absolute O(k/N^2) term is retained.

local_diagnostics.scope: Finite asymptotic diagnostics; the uniform estimates are proved analytically.

original_source.scope: All channels summed inside the original W/pi coupons, with actual cups and unrestricted marked cap; independently summed positive face factors retain every omega phase and N^R measure.

tetrahedral.scope: All original internal labels and exact half-twist ratios are summed. Finite Gaussian errors are diagnostics, not a proof of the graph-wide estimate.

scope: Original finite recurrence, scalar/parity/phase identities, actual whole signed W/pi source sums and independent positive coefficients. Uniform relative estimates, signed noncancellation and general volume equality are analytical theorems; finite asymptotic profiles only diagnose their constants.
